count.zh: 张订单，大多赶在周末出发前
count.en: orders, most placed right before a weekend away

intro.zh: {name}，这一年你下了{orders}单，大多为了出发。

story.why: Outdoor is 36% of orders, gas canisters were bought 11 times, 74% of orders land on weekends and the peak was a May Day streak. That makes them a weekend camper, and camp meals are the natural next thing to cook on all that gas.
